doc: PROFILE.md 5.2: 'pdal translate f.las f.las now refuses. Exit status 255, the diagnostic `PDAL: Input and output filenames are equal and no --overwrite option was provided!`, and the input file left byte-for-byte untouched.' -- the refusal happens before the writer opens the file, so the 10x10x10 lattice is still there afterwards. At 2.4.0 the same command exits 0 and rewrites the file in place: 34227 bytes before and after, but the coordinates are all zero. Section 4 of TEST_INTERFACE.md rules out whole-file byte equality, so the untouched-file claim is graded at the content level: after the refusal the input still reads back as its 1000-point self with X/Y/Z min, max and mean unchanged.
